values.task_boundary: Add the narrow atomic operation, repair only issue 5591 terminal validation portability, and integrate the three exact terminal projections.
deliverables: Typed repair request schema and closeout command
Atomic store implementation with exact CAS and rollback
Portable issue 5591 SOR and regenerated receipt
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Distinct active authority and exact authority/target/receipt CAS are required
AC-2: Target must remain closed-out and claim-free
AC-3: Exactly one complete old validation result must match
AC-4: Malformed or machine-local replacement results fail closed
AC-5: Success atomically regenerates SOR, projections, audit, digest, and retained receipt
AC-6: Interrupted receipt update restores prior record, cards, audit, and receipt bytes
AC-7: Issue 5591 retained SOR contains no machine-local absolute path
AC-8: Unsupported guardian-soak JSON is absent from the corrective branch
AC-9: Issues 5337, 5339, and 5591 preserve original terminal identities and dispositions
AC-10: Fresh checkout sees all three targets closed-out, claim-free, doctor-clean, and non-colliding
dependencies: Retained terminal receipts for issues 5337, 5339, 5358, 5591, and 5602
Existing terminal transaction and receipt-refresh implementation
repo_inputs: csdlc-v2 existing serde, serde_json, and schemars dependencies
csdlc-v2 terminal repair operations and transaction journal
non_goals: No Runtime v2 or ADL-v2 changes
No issue reopening or terminal identity replacement
No AWS or external provider execution
